name: London Low Emission Zone
law: Greater London Low Emission Zone Charging Order 2006, as varied (Euro VI standard for heavy vehicles from 2021-03-01): lorries over 3.5 t that don't meet Euro VI (NOx and PM) pay GBP 100 a day if they meet Euro IV (PM), GBP 300 if not; charging days run midnight to midnight, every day (TfL). Euro IV and V are taken as meeting Euro IV (PM).
